summary: Backend testing complete for location sharing feature - All 12 tests passed. POST /api/location/update returns {ok: true} and GET /api/friends/locations returns array of friend locations.
critical_code_review_comments: LocationUpdate model correctly validates lat bounds (-90 to 90) and lng bounds (-180 to 180)
POST /api/location/update properly stores location with timestamp in user's 'last_location' field
GET /api/friends/locations correctly filters friends with location updates within last 30 minutes
Both endpoints require authentication (return 401 without Bearer token)
Response structures match expected format: {ok: true} for update, array with id/username/lat/lng/updated_at for locations
